decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event captures leaderboard totals but omits the requirement that each ticket and its $5 commission be accounted to the same recipient NFT.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
So far, we have done 12 mints, that should equal 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**When there is no referral code used, there is still a ticket and commission**.

Right now, **when a code is used**, it is correctly accounted for on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

When there is **no referral code used**, the ticket and commission are randomly assigned.
(B**ut they still need to be accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I think since your last fix, (on the last 2 mints) the randomly assigned tickets have been accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
But they have not been backfilled to show the missing tickets.

And the commissions (from these no code buys) are still not being accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot you'll see i have an NFT with 2 tickets and only 1 x $5 commission - this should be impossible, as every ticket comes with a $5 commission.

And on my leaderboard screenshot, you can count (from 12 total mints) 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions accounted for.
12 mints should equal 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions, regardless of a referral code being used or not.

value_updates.leaderboard_reward_totals: Leaderboard totals must include one ticket and one $5 commission for every primary mint, including rewards assigned randomly after a no-code mint.
value_updates.leaderboard_ticket_commission_pairing: Each ticket accounted on the leaderboard must have its corresponding $5 commission accounted to the same recipient NFT.

decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event defines the no-code reward package but does not explicitly preserve the client-required pairing of the ticket and commission to the same random recipient NFT.

value_updates.referral_operation: Each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code; coded referrals earn $5 and one current Small Block prize ticket, while a mint without a referral code sends one $5 commission and one Small Block prize ticket together to a randomly selected existing NFT holder.

decisions.reason: The source reports that coded-referral rewards are already correctly accounted and does not change the existing $5 commission and one-ticket reward.
Reward accounting and recipient pairing do not change the rule that an NFT's own mint number is its referral code.
The source concerns referral reward accounting after primary mints and does not change the deferred Transak payment flow.
The ticket and commission accounting rule does not affect the badge set, icons, count, or layout.
The landing-page mechanics copy already states one entry and a $5 commission for referrals, and the source does not request a landing-page wording change.
The existing invalid/no-code message already describes one $5 commission and one $500 prize ticket going to a random existing NFT holder.
Referral ticket and commission accounting does not change automatic prize payout, winner announcements, or notifications.
The source distinguishes coded and no-code accounting but does not alter which referral codes are valid or the self-referral restriction.
The hero already advertises a $5 commission and one prize entry, and the source does not require a hero-copy change.
